q.en: Do you coordinate certified Halal and culturally authentic catering in Perth?

a.en: Yes. We work with verified Perth caterers offering certified Halal banquets, Middle Eastern, South Asian, Mediterranean, East Asian and modern Australian menus, with full dietary tracking via your digital RSVPs.

q.en: Can our digital invitation include multiple events like a Mehndi, tea ceremony and reception?

a.en: Yes. Our Timeline view supports multi-part and multi-day ceremonies, each with its own venue map, schedule and `.ics` calendar entry.
